p0.018#0.en: do the will of the Father in heaven

p1.002#0.en: You have created the heaven and the heaven of heavens, with all their hosts

p1.004#0.en: God created the heavens and formed the earth; he established the universe and created this world not in vain; he formed it to be inhabited

p1.006#0.en: Be you perfect, even as I am perfect

p3.003#0.en: whither shall I flee from your presence?
